capabilities: Lay images written consecutively in one paragraph into an equal-height row
Render alt-text captions and optional EXIF data under images
Control layouts with ```photos fenced blocks (grid, masonry, scroll, crop, row counts)
Fetch a JSON album index for image dimensions, variant widths and EXIF
Optionally upload pasted or dropped images to a self-configured endpoint
disambiguation: Not a site generator or publishing tool; it only previews in the vault the layout a static-site generator sharing the same rules will produce.
extras: Marked in the manifest as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents network use and states no requests are made unless the optional index, base and upload URLs are configured. Notes a live-preview limitation when a photos block is nested very deep.
problem: Obsidian lays embedded images out one per line at their natural width, with no way to group same-paragraph images into rows, grids or masonry while writing.

relations.evidence: The layout is modelled on hexo-theme-linen by LynanBreeze (MIT)

requires.name: self-configured upload endpoint, album index URL, site base URL

summary: Renders consecutive images in one paragraph as an equal-height photo row with captions and EXIF; ```photos fences add grid, masonry and scroll layouts.
